user.title: Broadlink Plug Timer
user.description: Adds actions that write timers directly into Broadlink SP3S plugs (dead-man switch, one-time and weekly switching). Set up the plugs in the Broadlink integration first; the actions use their switch entities.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Broadlink Plug Timer is already set up. One entry serves all plugs.

read.name: Read timers
read.description: Reads state, clock and all timers of a Broadlink SP3S plug, in plug time and in local time.

entity_id.name: Plug
entity_id.description: Switch entity of the plug (Broadlink integration).

set_deadman.name: Set dead-man switch-off
set_deadman.description: Writes a one-time switch-off into the plug, the given minutes after the plug clock. Replaces the previous dead-man entry. Call it right before switching on: if Home Assistant does not switch off in time, the plug does it by itself.

entity_id.name: Plug
entity_id.description: Switch entity of the plug (Broadlink integration).

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: Planned run time plus a reserve, 1 to 1440 minutes.

clear_deadman.name: Clear dead-man switch-off
clear_deadman.description: Removes the dead-man entry and expired one-time entries from the plug.

entity_id.name: Plug
entity_id.description: Switch entity of the plug (Broadlink integration).

set_once.name: Set one-time switching
set_once.description: Adds a one-time switch-on and switch-off in local time. The plug runs it by itself, without Home Assistant. Saves a backup of the plug memory first.

entity_id.name: Plug
entity_id.description: Switch entity of the plug (Broadlink integration).

on_time.name: Switch on
on_time.description: Local date and time to switch on.

off_time.name: Switch off
off_time.description: Local date and time to switch off (after switch on).

write_weekly.name: Write weekly schedule
write_weekly.description: Replaces the whole weekly table of the plug (like the Broadlink app) with the given entries in local time. Writes only if the plug differs; saves a backup first. Call it daily, because the plug clock does not follow daylight saving time.

entity_id.name: Plug
entity_id.description: Switch entity of the plug (Broadlink integration).

entries.name: Entries
entries.description: List of entries: days ("mon-fri", "sat,sun" or a list), on_time and off_time ("HH:MM"), enabled (default true). Every on_time needs an off_time; an off_time earlier than the on_time means the next day. At most 16 entries in plug time.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: Only return what would be written.

backup.name: Back up plug memory
backup.description: Saves the raw timer memory of the plug into the folder broadlink_plug_timer in the configuration folder.

entity_id.name: Plug
entity_id.description: Switch entity of the plug (Broadlink integration).

restore.name: Restore plug timers
restore.description: Writes the weekly and one-time tables of a backup back into the plug. Name and other settings of the plug stay.

entity_id.name: Plug
entity_id.description: Switch entity of the plug (Broadlink integration).

file.name: Backup file
file.description: File name in the folder broadlink_plug_timer, as returned by the backup action.
